api: HTTP API layer — route definitions and request/response handling
routes: Route handlers — maps URL paths to controller functions
controllers: Controller layer — processes requests and delegates to services
handlers: Request handlers — endpoint logic and response formatting
services: Business logic / service layer — core application operations
service: Business logic / service layer — core application operations
middleware: Middleware pipeline — authentication, logging, validation, CORS
models: Data models / ORM entities — database table definitions and schemas
schemas: Data schemas — Pydantic/Zod/Joi validation shapes for request/response
db: Database layer — connection setup, query helpers, migration runners
database: Database layer — connection setup, query helpers, migration runners
repositories: Repository pattern — typed async CRUD operations per data entity
repo: Repository pattern — typed async CRUD operations per data entity
workers: Background workers — async task processors and job consumers
tasks: Celery/BullMQ task definitions — async job payloads and queue routing
jobs: Scheduled / queued jobs — cron tasks and background processing
queues: Message queues — event publishing and consumer group management
config: Configuration — environment variable loading and app settings
settings: Application settings — environment variable parsing and validation
utils: Utility functions — shared helpers used across multiple modules
helpers: Helper functions — common utilities and convenience methods
lib: Shared library code — reusable functions and utility classes
libs: Shared library code — reusable functions and utility classes
common: Shared common code — cross-cutting utilities and base types
shared: Shared modules — code reused across features or packages
core: Core business logic — domain rules and fundamental application behaviour
domain: Domain layer — business entities, value objects, and domain services
types: TypeScript/Python type definitions — interfaces, enums, and shared types
interfaces: Interface definitions — contracts between modules and layers
dto: Data Transfer Objects — structured request/response payload shapes
dtos: Data Transfer Objects — structured request/response payload shapes
components: UI components — reusable frontend building blocks
pages: Page-level components — top-level route views for the frontend
views: View templates or page components — user-facing rendered screens
hooks: React/Vue hooks — stateful logic extracted into reusable functions
store: State management store — global application state (Redux/Zustand/Pinia)
stores: State management stores — global application state modules
context: React context providers — global shared state and dependency injection
assets: Static assets — images, fonts, icons, and other media files
static: Static files — publicly served assets (CSS, JS, images)
public: Public directory — files served directly by the web server
styles: CSS/SCSS stylesheets — global styles and design system tokens
css: CSS stylesheets — component and global styles
migrations: Database migration files — versioned schema change scripts
seeds: Database seed files — initial data population scripts
fixtures: Test fixtures — sample data and mock objects for testing
tests: Test suite — unit, integration, and end-to-end test files
test: Test suite — unit, integration, and end-to-end test files
__tests__: Jest test suite — unit and integration test files
e2e: End-to-end tests — full user-flow tests against a running application
scripts: Utility / build scripts — automation scripts for dev and CI tasks
bin: Binary / executable scripts — CLI entry points and shell utilities
cmd: Command entry points — main application entry (common in Go projects)
docker: Docker configuration — Compose files, Dockerfiles, and container setup
k8s: Kubernetes manifests — deployment, service, and ingress definitions
infra: Infrastructure-as-code — Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation configs
terraform: Terraform modules — cloud infrastructure provisioning scripts
ci: CI/CD configuration — pipeline definitions for build and deploy automation
.github: GitHub configuration — Actions workflows, PR templates, issue forms
docs: Documentation — guides, API references, and architecture notes
examples: Usage examples — sample code demonstrating key features
prisma: Prisma ORM — schema definition and generated database client
graphql: GraphQL schema — type definitions, resolvers, and mutations
proto: Protocol Buffers — gRPC service and message definitions
grpc: gRPC service layer — remote procedure call handlers and stubs
events: Event definitions — domain events and message schemas
extensions: Extension modules — optional add-ons to the core system
packages: Monorepo packages — individual packages in a workspace
apps: Monorepo applications — deployable apps in the monorepo
internal: Internal packages — private code not exported from the module (Go pattern)
pkg: Public packages — exported library code (Go pattern)
